title_vi: all / most / some / any / no/none (tất cả / hầu hết / một số / không …)
theory_html:
A. children / money / books (in general) and the children / the money / these books

A. children / money / books (nói chung) và the children / the money / these books

in general
nói chung		specific
cụ thể
Children like playing. (= children in general)Where are the children? (= our children)
Money isn’t everything. (= money in general)I want to buy a car, but I don’t have the money. (= the money for a car)
I enjoy reading books.Have you read these books?
Everybody needs friends.I often go out with my friends.

B. most / most of … , some / some of … etc.

B. most / most of … , some / some of … v.v.

most / some etc. + noun
+ danh từ		most of / some of etc. + the / this / my …
+ the / this / my …
All cities have the same problems. (= cities in general)All (of) the students in our class passed the exam.
Most children like playing. (= children in general)Most of the children at this school are under 11 years old.
Some books are better than others.Some of these books are very old.
I don’t want any money.I don’t want any of this money.
He has no friends.None of my friends live near me.

You can say all the … or all of the … (with or without of):

Có thể nói all the … hoặc all of the … (có hoặc không có of):

  • All the students in our class passed the exam. (or All of the students …)

    Tất cả học sinh lớp chúng tôi đều đỗ.

  • Amy has lived in London all her life. (or … all of her life.)

    Amy đã sống ở London cả đời.

Do not use of in these sentences:

Không dùng of trong những câu này:

  • Most people drive too fast. (not Most of people)

    Hầu hết mọi người lái xe quá nhanh. (không nói Most of people)

  • Some birds can’t fly. (not Some of birds)

    Một số loài chim không biết bay. (không nói Some of birds)

C. all of it / most of them / none of us etc.

C. all of it / most of them / none of us v.v.

all / most / some / any / none + of + it / them / us / you

all / most / some / any / none + of + it / them / us / you

  • You can have some of this cake, but not all of it.

    Bạn có thể ăn một ít bánh này, nhưng không phải tất cả.

  • A: Do you know those people? B: Most of them, but not all of them.

    A: Bạn có quen những người kia không? B: Hầu hết, nhưng không phải tất cả.

  • Some of us are going out tonight. Why don’t you come with us?

    Vài người trong chúng tôi tối nay đi chơi. Sao bạn không đi cùng?

  • I have a lot of books, but I haven’t read any of them.

    Tôi có nhiều sách, nhưng chưa đọc cuốn nào.

  • ‘How many of these books have you read?’ ‘None of them.’

    ‘Bạn đã đọc bao nhiêu cuốn trong số này?’ ‘Chưa cuốn nào.’

mcq.question: ___ like playing. (= children in general)
mcq.full: Children like playing. (= children in general)
mcq.vi: Trẻ em thích chơi đùa. (= trẻ em nói chung)
mcq.expl:
Noun alone = in general (children, money); the/these/my + noun = specific.
Danh từ đứng một mình = nói chung (children, money); the/these/my + danh từ = cụ thể.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Nói chung → không the.
mcq.key: ___ like playing. (= children in general)|Children
